arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS online_over_2000_transactions FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' AND amount_usd_cents > 200000
arguments.explanation: Counts all online transactions whose amount is above $2,000, regardless of fraud label status.
assumptions: The count covers all transactions in the data (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31), including those with no fraud label.
